style.checked: Continuous oblique courtyard eating/listening scene, digital ink and luminous washes.
observations: Cropped soup fills lower-right foreground; seated adults face the flute player at left. Contours and amber washes remain coherent across the scene.
issues: A large pale wall/erased wall area behind the left title/date cluster, and a second pale upper-right wall behind the practical cluster, serve as manufactured information planes.

substantive_visual.evidence: Foreground seasonal green soup, reusable cups and seated listening adults connect by a diagonal to the flutist; action and sightlines convey one food/music event.

hangul.observations: Title has variable broad-pen weight with open counters; practical Hangul maintains even proportions and word gaps. Usage720 preserves word recognition and the small colons/dash.

information_relationship.observations: Title/date cluster is the first anchor at thumbnail; meal and listening group occupy the near diagonal. At usage720 identity → date/hours → upper-right venue/entry/purchase/participation → lower-right cup reminder → lower-left invitation are findable.
information_relationship.issue: Upper practical typography is organized mainly on two empty wall fields rather than being shaped by the active drawing.

function_contact.observations: Flute is visibly held horizontally at the mouth by both hands. Bowls and cups are held by neighbors with distinguishable contours; ladle is resting in the serving bowl. No required mechanical correspondence or client identity.

local_finish.observations: Blue-green contours, warm amber light and fresh green soup remain consistent. Bowl edge and ladle overlaps are legible, with no copy clipped by the frame.

format.observations: Single flat opaque landscape poster; no real promoter identity, QR, logo, watermark or room mockup observed.

basic_style_exclusion.location: Upper center-left title/date backing and upper-right venue/arrival backing
basic_style_exclusion.observation: Broad blank rendered wall areas are reserved for title and information; the scene's connected actions are substantive but these planes retain the user's specifically excluded text-bearing wall relation.

located_observations.observation: The soup rim is cropped by bottom/right, listeners diminish toward the flute player; the meal/music relationship is direct.
Practical information is small but legible; cup reminder wraps after 컵을.
Large title/date backed by pale wall is the strongest text anchor; the front soup is the strongest object.

residuals: Manufactured blank wall planes carry the major headline and practical blocks, contrary to the explicit composition exclusion.
Raster glyph shapes permit optical reading, not certification of original Unicode code points.

repair_decision.cause: Actual explicit wall-plane composition exclusion remains; not a coordinate or planned-size mismatch.
